title: Structural basis of the regulation of the normal and oncogenic methylation of nucleosomal histone H3 Lys36 by NSD2.
authors: Sato, Ko; Kumar, Amarjeet; Hamada, Keisuke; Okada, Chikako; Oguni, Asako; Machiyama, Ayumi; Sakuraba, Shun; Nishizawa, Tomohiro; Nureki, Osamu; Kono, Hidetoshi; Ogata, Kazuhiro; Sengoku, Toru
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和分子动力学模拟研究NSD2与核小体的结合及致癌突变对H3K36甲基化的调控，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和MD模拟，但核心是组蛋白甲基转移酶而非TF-DNA转录结合体系，对象偏离且无AI方法。
abstract: Dimethylated histone H3 Lys36 (H3K36me2) regulates gene expression, and aberrant H3K36me2 upregulation, resulting from either the overexpression or point mutation of the dimethyltransferase NSD2, is found in various cancers. Here we report the cryo-electron microscopy structure of NSD2 bound to the nucleosome. Nucleosomal DNA is partially unwrapped, facilitating NSD2 access to H3K36. NSD2 interacts with DNA and H2A along with H3. The NSD2 autoinhibitory loop changes its conformation upon nucleosome binding to accommodate H3 in its substrate-binding cleft. Kinetic analysis revealed that two oncogenic mutations, E1099K and T1150A, increase NSD2 catalytic turnover. Molecular dynamics simulations suggested that in both mutants, the autoinhibitory loop adopts an open state that can accommodate H3 more often than the wild-type. We propose that E1099K and T1150A destabilize the interactions that keep the autoinhibitory loop closed, thereby enhancing catalytic turnover. Our analyses guide the development of specific inhibitors of NSD2.
abstract_zh: 二甲基化组蛋白H3赖氨酸36（H3K36me2）调控基因表达，而由二甲基转移酶NSD2的过表达或点突变导致的异常H3K36me2上调，在多种癌症中被发现。在此，我们报告了NSD2与核小体结合的冷冻电镜结构。核小体DNA部分解绕，便于NSD2接近H3K36。NSD2与DNA、H2A及H3相互作用。NSD2的自抑制环在与核小体结合后改变其构象，以适应H3进入其底物结合裂隙。动力学分析显示，两种致癌突变E1099K和T1150A增加了NSD2的催化周转率。分子动力学模拟表明，在这两种突变体中，自抑制环比野生型更常采用能容纳H3的开放状态。我们提出，E1099K和T1150A破坏了维持自抑制环闭合状态的相互作用，从而增强了催化周转。我们的分析为开发NSD2特异性抑制剂提供了指导。
